name: mila-telegram
description: Telegram channel for Claude Code for teams and small businesses: a receiver daemon that keeps the bot online while the session restarts, groups with per-chat modes and owner approval, voice transcription, reply-quote context, inline buttons. Fork of Anthropic's Telegram channel plugin (Apache-2.0).

bot_token.title: Telegram bot token
bot_token.description: The token @BotFather gave you (digits, a colon, then letters). Stored in your system's secure credential store. Leave empty if you already saved it with the configure skill (it goes to ~/.claude/channels/telegram/.env).
